# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. It reworks the singleton lifecycle, adds variable font and color-font-palette support, animated WebP encoding, and zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. This is a breaking release with several behavioral changes from the Skia m132 engine jump — check the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — The property changed type from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost IEquatable/operator== support. Update field access and replace equality comparisons that relied on Equals/== on GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose no longer has a public setter** — The property is now get-only. Remove any direct assignment to IgnorePublicDispose from derived types.
- **new SKFont() and new SKPaint() no longer default to a null Typeface** — SKFont's typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty instead of null (so MeasureText returns 0 until you set one), and SKPaint's is SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Replace `Typeface == null` checks with `Typeface.IsEmpty`, and pass an explicit typeface to SKFont when you need text metrics. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735), [#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default are now never null** — A missing family (including on Android) now resolves to SKTypeface.Default instead of null, and SKTypeface.Default itself is guaranteed non-null on every platform. For a strict "was it found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily, which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The previously silent truncating cast to int is now a checked cast that throws OverflowException for out-of-range offsets, and the overload is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset instead. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on a Vulkan 1.0 instance** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a sub-1.1 instance or an unset GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion causes a fatal native abort instead of CreateVulkan returning null. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion, and fall back to raster on genuinely 1.0-only hardware. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; the rest have no replacement. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to milestone m148** — Updates the bundled Skia engine from m132 through m148, folding in several rounds of upstream Chrome bug fixes merged across the preview cycle. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette support and improved variable font robustness. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data** — Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData() for converting a stream to SKData without copying. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New API wrappers and HBColor struct** — Adds a proper HBColor struct for hb_color_t, adds SKSamplingOptions support to SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and fills in missing API wrappers while fixing naming-convention violations. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access and finalizer fixes** — GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for offsets on both SKPixmap and SKBitmap, and a finalizer crash is fixed when an SKPathBuilder is collected before its SKPath. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default-typeface and WinUI fixes** — Moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer, and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Platform

- **New native asset targets** — Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 Tizen native builds, and PolySharp-based C# 13 support on legacy target frameworks; also fixes SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry), [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3642](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3642), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates expat to 2.8.1, harfbuzz to 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds variable-font shaping support and the new HBColor value type, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
